name: thanos_receive_high_replication_failures
title: Thanos Receive High Replication Failures
description: Thanos Receive is failing to replicate a high percentage of requests.

source.upstream_query: thanos_receive_replication_factor > 1 and ((sum by (job) (rate(thanos_receive_replications_total{result="error"}[5m])) / sum by (job) (rate(thanos_receive_replications_total[5m]))) > (max by (job) (floor((thanos_receive_replication_factor+1)/ 2)) / max by (job) (thanos_receive_hashring_nodes))) * 100
source.upstream_description: Thanos Receive {{$labels.job}} is failing to replicate {{$value | humanize}}% of requests.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: (thanos_receive_replication_factor > 1 and ((sum by (job) (rate(thanos_receive_replications_total{result="error"}[5m])) / sum by (job) (rate(thanos_receive_replications_total[5m]))) > (max by (job) (floor((thanos_receive_replication_factor+1)/ 2)) / max by (job) (thanos_receive_hashring_nodes))) * 100) * 0 + 1
